description: Verify that DUT's ICMP Echo Reply echoes the Identifier and Sequence Number fields verbatim from the matching Echo Request — these let the requester correlate Replies to outstanding Requests (RFC 792 Echo Request/Reply MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
A ping client may have many outstanding Echo Requests at once. The Identifier (typically the client's pid or socket id) and Sequence Number (per-Request counter) tell it which Reply matches which Request. DUT must copy both fields verbatim.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Echo Request with a chosen identifier and sequence number (e.g. id=0xABCD, seq=0x0042)

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: ICMP Echo Reply
      - identifier == 0xABCD   ← key check 1
      - sequence   == 0x0042   ← key check 2

[Pass condition]
Both identifier and sequence fields in the Reply match the Request.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_echo_id — identifier in Reply did not match Request
• Fail_echo_seq — sequence in Reply did not match Request
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a Reply within the window

verdicts.Pass: Reply echoed identifier and sequence — normal correlation possible
verdicts.Fail_echo_id: Reply identifier did not match Request
verdicts.Fail_echo_seq: Reply sequence number did not match Request
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit a Reply within the window
